properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 18 at 4:52PM MDT until September 18 at 7:45PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Moffat County in northwestern Colorado...
Western Rio Blanco County in northwestern Colorado...
East Central Uintah County in northeastern Utah...

* Until 745 PM MDT.

* At 452 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, and streets.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Dinosaur, Artesia and Blue Mountain.
properties.areaDesc: Moffat, CO; Rio Blanco, CO; Uintah, UT

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 18 at 4:47PM MDT until September 18 at 5:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
SVRBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South Central Adams County in northeastern Colorado...
Central Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 515 PM MDT.

* At 447 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Watkins, or
18 miles east of Denver, moving northeast at 20 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Eastern Aurora, Manila Village and Watkins.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 18 at 4:31PM MDT until September 18 at 5:30PM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
SVRGLD

The National Weather Service in Goodland has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Eastern Kit Carson County in east central Colorado...
Sherman County in northwestern Kansas...

* Until 530 PM MDT.

* At 430 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 6 miles northwest
of Kanorado, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect considerable tree damage. Damage is likely to
mobile homes, roofs, and outbuildings.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Kanorado around 440 PM MDT.

Other locations in the path of this severe thunderstorm include
Ruleton.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 70 in Kansas between mile markers 0 and 28.
Interstate 70 in Colorado between mile markers 435 and 450.
Highway 385 between mile markers 177 and 206, and near mile marker
211.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 18 at 4:31PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 431 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from near Commerce City to over western
Parker, or extending from 8 miles northeast of Denver to 17 miles
southeast of Denver, moving northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Eastern Denver, Aurora, eastern Centennial, eastern Commerce City,
Parker, Denver International Airport, D.I.A Terminal and
Concourses, Buckley SFB, Arapahoe Park and Foxfield.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 18 at 4:22PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around

Locations impacted include...
Arickaree School, Anton, Thurman and Cope.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 18 at 4:13PM MDT until September 18 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Mesa County in west central Colorado...

* Until 715 PM MDT.

* At 413 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.4 and 0.8 inches of
rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 3 inches in
1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Loma and Mack. This includes portions of I-70 between mile markers
8 and 15.
